description: Whether one product fits one vehicle: 'yes' with the fit options and the price and page for the vehicle, 'not listed', or 'by what it mounts to' for carriers. Also what the product needs (crossbars, a hitch, required parts) and what checkout will ask. The product is its rackwarehouse.com page URL, its handle or its SKU.

make.description: Make handle or name, e.g. toyota (find_vehicle gives it)

model.description: Model handle or name, e.g. corolla

roof_type.description: e.g. Naked Roof, Raised Rails, Flush Rails, Fixed Point, Tracks, Gutter

name: check_fit
title: Check fit
